beats.title: Ride to Stone Bridge with Pippa; encounter with stuck fisherman's net
beats.summary: The party accepts Pippa's offer of a ride to Stone Bridge; Pippa hitches Bubbles the Float Goat to a keg wagon and leads them to a dock and barge. Downriver they encounter an elderly fisherman whose net is stuck, and Bonogo dives in, eventually Stafl and Baergrom pull up what looks like corner beams of a roof.

beats.title: At Stone Bridge: storm coming, drinks at River's Edge Pub, Grishna, and another bard
beats.summary: Arriving at Stone Bridge, they unload beer, see a storm coming, and go into the River's Edge Pub for beers and bragging to Grishna. Inside is the evening crew, Grishna, patrons, and another bard; Stafl joins a jam. Pippa notices the loud drumming is actually torrential rain and goes to check on Bubbles, then weeping and a piercing yell are heard.

into the River’s Edge Pub for a welcome round of beers and some bragging to Grishna about their adventures.
Pippa realizes the loud drumming isn’t just the bard, but a torrent of rain on the roof excuses herself to check on Bubbles.

beats.title: Pippa's cry: BUBBLES!
beats.summary: Pippa's piercing yell resolves into a shout of BUBBLES.

beats.title: Flood rescue: Pippa stranded, Bubbles on a rock, rope and mage hand fail, Bonogo swept away
beats.summary: Rushing outside, they find Pippa soaked and panicked, gripping the pub in rushing water. Bubbles is found bleating on a rock; a lasso and mage hand are made, Stafl gathers townfolk with nets, Bonogo and Baergrom prepare to dive, Caelynn fires ice bolts, and Stafl helps townsfolk escape to the pub. The mage hand and rope fail when Bubbles bites, and Bonogo dives with trust in Baergrom, but the rope is torn away and Bonogo is carried out of sight.

anchor_quotes: found Pippa, soaked and panicked.

the Float Goat panics and bites, destroying the mage hand and dropping the rope into the water.
Bonogo dives into the river with full trust in Baergrom to hold the rope, which is immediately torn out of Baergrom’s hand.

beats.title: Pursuit downriver: Karsemine, Stafl and Caelynn chase Bonogo; Bubbles rescued
beats.summary: Karsemine casts Zephyr strike and shoots arrows down the bank; Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy and follow Bonogo with a lit net. Ephanna and the mage hand coax Bubbles, get her to the dock, and Ephanna rides Bubbles after the runaway boats.

Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy and let the river take them after Bonogo, with only a net with light cast on it and hope.
Ephanna and the mage hand coaxed Bubbles to the lasso and were able to get her to the dock across the ice path and rushing river.

beats.title: Aftermath: rescued, heroes of Stone Bridge, and the question of Mirathorn
beats.summary: Bonogo is rescued, the adventurers return to the pub to find a damp but relieved town, sleep, and wake to ask what now. They are heroes of Stone Bridge and saviors of Bubbles, and consider Pippa's mention of the city Mirathorn and its festival, about a week away on foot.
